title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to announce the full availability of Spyglass, a powerful new tool designed to bring enhanced capabilities and insights to your fingertips.

title: Enhanced File Control & Display
summary: Take full command of your content with enhanced tools that allow you to easily manage, upload, and customize the visual presentation of all your files and media within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to discover recently shipped features, what's next in development, and our exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Experience a smoother and more visually integrated workflow with our enhanced checkboxes, now boasting improved clickability, a refreshed design, and effortless drag-and-drop functionality.

title: Seamless Editor Collaboration
summary: Experience smoother teamwork with enhanced editor collaboration that makes working together clearer and easier than ever before.

title: Enhanced Sharing & Collaboration
summary: Effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared items with your connections, making teamwork more intuitive and productive.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for various international languages to connect with users worldwide.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with greater control, transparency, and the opportunity to directly contribute to its exciting future.

title: Smarter Knowledge Graph Navigation and Discovery
summary: Navigate your entire knowledge base with enhanced precision, utilizing powerful filters for tags and time, alongside integrated sharing, to kickstart your workflows and uncover valuable insights.

title: Smart Search Filters and Curated Collections
summary: Transform your search experience by applying powerful filters to quickly find and save exactly what you need in personalized, easy-to-access collections.

title: Flexible Content Displays
summary: Organize your thoughts more intuitively and interactively with new flexible display options for linked content.

title: Noeko: Unleash Your Potential with Self-Hosting and Flexible Plans
summary: Experience unparalleled control and unlock advanced capabilities with Noeko's upcoming self-hosting option and new flexible premium plans, designed to fit your unique requirements.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Stunning Themes
summary: Get ready for a visual refresh as we polish existing themes and introduce a diverse collection of beautiful new designs, making your workspace more vibrant and personalized.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more precise and welcoming experience as we ensure our greetings always perfectly match your local time of day.

title: Enhanced List Management and Quick Actions
summary: Streamline your workflow with new quick actions, allowing you to unapply tags, delete items, and more, directly from your lists.

title: Bring All Your Information Together
summary: Effortlessly integrate a broader range of content, including videos, websites, and text, to centralize all your valuable information and streamline your learning.
